The letter {{AurB|c}} was the third letter of the [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] alphabet and corresponded to the [[High Galactic/Legends|High Galactic]] letter ''c''. It was pronounced "cresh"<ref name="Written Word">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/writtenword/index.html?page=1|text=The Written Word|int=The Written Word}}</ref> and had a phonetic value of /k/ or /s/. Additionally, it was a [[Key of Cresh|musical key]].
